exposure: Fasting blood glucose levels during pregnancy
cohort: The study included 1449 mothers in Chengdu, capital city of Sichuan Province, Western China.
finding: Chinese women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) reported significantly higher mean Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale (EPDS) scores at both 1-month and 3-month postpartum, indicating increased susceptibility to postnatal depressive symptoms.
